Definition
[Lichnerowicz Laplacian] 1. ch2:3.7 Source: topping:page-0031 \group topping-background

For a symmetric $2$-tensor $h$, \[ (\Delta _{\mathcal L}h)(X,W):=(\Delta h)(X,W)-h(X,\Ric (W))-h(W,\Ric (X)) +2\tr h(R(X,\cdot )W,\cdot ). \]
